gui.jriksseedfinder.title: Jrik's Seed Finder
gui.jriksseedfinder.nether_portals.on: Ruined portals in the nether: noted
gui.jriksseedfinder.nether_portals.off: Ruined portals in the nether: not noted
gui.jriksseedfinder.nether_portals.toolt: Switch this on only if this world's nether was made by Minecraft 1.18.2 or newer. In nether chunks made by 1.16 to 1.18.1, ruined portals sit on another grid and would mislead the search.
gui.jriksseedfinder.start_over.title: Remove all notes for this world?
gui.jriksseedfinder.start_over.message: The structures and bedrock noted here are deleted. Use this when the world was reset or replaced. Structures you removed or placed with /place stay left out.
